item.title: Stop Buttons Triggering Zoom When They’re Double Tapped
item.description: It’s annoying when your browser zooms if a button is rapidly tapped. There’s actually a really simple fix and no, you don’t have to prevent all zooming with a meta tag! (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Stop Treating CSS Container Queries Like Traditional Media Queries
item.description: Despite broad browser support, container queries remain surprisingly underused and frequently misunderstood. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Component Testing: A Practical Guide for Frontend Developers
item.description: Learn how to test UI components in isolation with confidence. This is a guide for frontend developers on component testing that covers common techniques and the tools leading teams use. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Transitions.dev: Essential UI Transitions for Web Apps
item.description: Collection of the most essential UI transitions for web apps. Copy and paste them, or use them with your coding agent via the skill. (1 source: frontendfocus)
